oneway_gate.motion: Independent native split bar halves retract inside same-cell rail housings.

mechanicalOperations: independent detached gate rail registration into42px fixed edges

integrationRequirements: Resolve actual device IDs, cardinal enum and world/grid mapping from project.
One-way gate output is not a second occupied cell; closed/open art never grants movement by itself.
Conveyor frame clock follows current accepted automatic movement.
Corner art labels are not authority for project reflection behavior.
Brake press feedback never advances simulation or creates recoil.
limitations: Actual C#/Shader/Unity import/prefab binding/Play Mode NOT_RUN; no original Unity project.
Generated native color planes can contain a narrow antialiased contour, not a16color palette.
